svg.title: V-Lo database structure
svg.text: Supabase (Postgres). Arrows are foreign keys: they point from the row that refers to the row it refers to.

text.tspan: per team: one login can coach
and record its own sets with
lifter, not to a team: their

svg.text: a team's or one person's programme
a plan given to one athlete
one training day for one athlete
recording_id (optional): where the plan meets the sensors
Foreign key: the row at the tail refers to the row the arrow points at.
A tag instead of a line: this column refers to a person (profiles) or a team, drawn as a tag to keep lines short.
Primary key, each row’s own id. All ids are uuids; a person’s id is their login id.
Deleting a plan, assignment or workout never deletes recordings: the set’s recording_id just becomes empty.
Plans belong to a team (team_id) or one person (owner_id). Workouts without assignment_id are free workouts.
